subject: Important Update: Upcoming Changes to Billing
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our billing system. Starting next month, we will be implementing a new payment processing platform to provide you with a more secure and efficient billing experience. Please make sure to update your payment information to avoid any service interruptions. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your continued support. Sincerely, The Billing Team
